rows: Equipment: Maintenance and inspection of the mechanical parts of the generator
Open an approved written work order for the required maintenance and the required precautions; general cleaning of the mechanical parts of the generator
Clean the filters of the high-pressure pump
Clean the filters of the bearing lubrication circuit
Test a sample of the bearing lubricating oil
Visual inspection of the oil pumps, the high-pressure pump and the oil gas extraction fan
Check the operation of the heaters in the lower and upper tanks
Inspect the oil flow indicators for each bearing
Check the oil levels in the unit lubrication tank
Inspect the generator air cooling water lines
Lubricate the generator air cooling pumps for each unit
Inspect the brake jacks and test their operation
The inspection and cleaning works on the mechanical speed governor system are carried out in accordance with the station's main equipment outage programme
